opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Cal. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1064.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Ronald D. Maines, Esq., of Washington, D. C., be appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this ease.
